keyVerseDR: "Now this is eternal life: That they may know thee, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent." (Jn 17:3)

level1.title: Jesus Prays for Us
level1.story: Jesus looked up to heaven and prayed. He prayed for His friends. Jesus prays for us too!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, teach me to pray. Amen.

activity.title: My praying hands
activity.intro: Trace your hand, then decorate it. Pray like Jesus!

level2.title: Jesus' Prayer for His Friends
level2.story: At the Last Supper, Jesus raised His eyes to heaven and said, "Father, the hour has come." He prayed that He would give glory to the Father. Jesus said eternal life is to know the one true God and Jesus Christ whom He sent. He prayed for His disciples, because they belonged to the Father. Jesus said, "I pray for them," and He prays for us too.
level2.keyLine: This is eternal life: that they may know thee.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does Jesus say eternal life is?
How can you get to know God better?
actions: Pray a novena to the Holy Spirit
level2.prayer: Father, help me know You and Your Son. Amen.

activity.title: I pray for others
activity.intro: Jesus prayed for His friends. Write 3 prayers for your family.
